answer.reason: Based on BLS QCEW data, Wisconsin's private-sector construction employment for NAICS 23 in December 2024 was 130,999 covered jobs, not 139,975.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Wisconsin, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 23 Construction?

A. 130,999 covered jobs
B. 139,975 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Wisconsin statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/55000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: B
